what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Brunei, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2014, the only year with a figure, IDMC recorded 51 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Brunei list floods.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Brunei.

when.text: 2014 is the only year with a figure in IDMC's data.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Brunei.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
